lure: An unusual sign-in to your bank account
ask: Verify your identity within 24 hours on a copied sign-in page

message.subject: Unusual sign-in to your Chase account
message.body: Dear Customer, we noticed a sign-in to your Chase account from a new device in Columbus, Ohio. If this was not you, verify your identity within 24 hours to avoid a hold on your card: [chase.com](https://chase-account-review.test/verify). Thank you for banking with Chase.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is not Chase.
reasons: The link goes to chase-account-review.test, not chase.com.
The page asks for the card number and the online banking password.
